title: 2 Shillings - Elizabeth II (1st portrait; with 'BRITT:OMN')

obverse.description:
Young laureate bust of Queen Elizabeth II right, legend around.

Note: with 'BRITT:OMN'
obverse.unabridged_legend: Elizabeth II Dei Gratia Britanniarum Omnium Regina
obverse.lettering_translation: Elizabeth II by the Grace of God Queen of all the Britains

reverse.description: Central Tudor rose surrounded by thistles, shamrocks and leeks, legend above, denomination and date below.
reverse.lettering:
FID: DEF:
E·F C·T
TWO SHILLINGS 1953

comments:
House of Windsor (1917 to date), Elizabeth II (1952-2022), Pre-decimal issues (1953-70).

The standard weight of these coins was 4/11 troy ounce (174.5 grains). Under the Coinage Act of 1946, the composition changed from .500 silver to .750 copper/.250 nickel but the weight remained unchanged.

Two die varieties exist for this type - Obverse 1 from the plastic set issue and Obverse 2 struck for circulation:
Obv 1 I of ELIZ between beads, faint silhouette, I of DEI just to the right of a bead, B of BRITT between beads;
Obv 2 I of ELIZ at a bead, sharper silhouette, I of DEI between beads, B of BRITT to the right of a bead;

Image above is reproduced with kind permission of Declan Magee and Numista member Sjoelund.

A special mint set was released comprising 2s. 6d. to 1/4d. ordinary business strikes in transparent envelopes (1,288,000 issued).
